jd_responsibilities: Develop and iterate on features for Android productivity applications, completing module-level development tasks under guidance from senior engineers
Learn and implement modern Android development tech stack including Kotlin, Jetpack components and Jetpack Compose
Gradually take full ownership of independent feature modules and deliver end-to-end feature implementation
Participate in code reviews, technical seminars and the implementation of team engineering best practices
Cooperate with product managers and UI/UX designers to sort out user requirements and convert business needs into feasible technical solutions
Monitor application runtime performance and stability, assist in troubleshooting and resolving online production failures
Write clean, maintainable and fully tested code complying with unified team coding specifications
jd_requirements: Bachelor's degree or higher, expected graduation in 2027
Solid computer science fundamentals, proficient in data structures, algorithms, operating systems and computer network principles
Skilled in at least one object-oriented programming language such as Java, Kotlin or C++
Basic Android development capabilities: familiar with Activity & Fragment lifecycle, Android core application components, mainstream UI components and basic event handling mechanisms
Hands-on project experience including academic course projects, open-source contribution or internship experience
Excellent problem-solving capability and self-directed learning skills
Clear logical expression, excellent cross-team collaboration awareness, strong work ownership
Able to conduct daily workplace communication in Mandarin, with basic English reading and writing proficiency
优先：Android 开发实习或独立 App 经验，熟悉 Kotlin 协程/Flow，了解 Android 性能优化，或算法竞赛/技术博客/GitHub 开源经历
extended.jd_summary: 负责网易互娱 Android 生产力应用（UU Booster、MuMu Player 等）功能迭代与模块开发，使用 Kotlin/Jetpack/Jetpack Compose 技术栈，参与代码评审、性能稳定性排查及与产品/设计协作。2027 届校招，工作地点新加坡。
extended.requirements_summary: 2027 届本科及以上，计算机基础扎实，掌握 Java/Kotlin/C++ 之一及 Android 基础（生命周期/组件/UI）。需有项目经验，中英文沟通能力；Android 实习、Kotlin 协程与性能优化经验优先。

match.reason: 主职责为 Android 客户端开发（Kotlin/Jetpack Compose），非 Web 前端或 AI/Agent 工程岗；公司简介虽提及 AI Agent 探索，但岗位本身为移动端生产力应用开发，与目标方向不匹配
